description: Linearly schedules the PWM carrier frequency from electrical frequency: carrier = fsw_lo at fe_lo, fsw_hi at fe_hi (clamped, linear between). Async-modulation experiment; the control loop stays closed throughout.

fe_lo.description: Electrical frequency at which carrier = fsw_lo (Hz).

fe_hi.description: Electrical frequency at which carrier = fsw_hi (Hz).
